item.title: SRTC Medical Laboratory Technology and Phlebotomy graduates honored in Pinning Ceremony - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: THOMASVILLE — Southern Regional Technical College's (SRTC) Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT) and Clinic Assistant (Phlebotomy) programs held a pinning ceremony on Wednesday, April 15, marking the completion of the programs for thirteen MLT students and eight Phlebotomy students.

item.title: 15 Thomas County Jail inmates baptized after yearlong Bible study - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: THOMASVILLE — Nearly 15 female inmates got baptized at the Thomas County Jail last week, following a year-long Bible study with Rev. Louwani Lopez of Willow Head Missionary Baptist Church and Patricia Oliver of Victory Fellowship Church.

item.title: THS to soon break ground on upgrading track and field facility - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: THOMASVILLE – The Thomasville Bulldogs are getting an upgrade this summer with their track and field facility.

item.description: Winged jewels of the air … flutterbys … no matter what you call butterflies, they entrance everyone.

item.title: Thomas County Central brings beloved classic to the stage this weekend - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: THOMASVILLE — Follow the Yellow Brick Road to the Thomasville Center for the Arts this Friday and Saturday, when the Thomas County Central High School Drama Department presents "The Wizard of Oz."

item.title: THS Senior Dhruket Patel named University of Georgia Foundation Fellow - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: THOMASVILLE — Thomasville High School senior Dhruket Patel has been selected as a Foundation Fellow at the University of Georgia, one of the university’s most prestigious honors awarded to incoming first-year students.

item.title: TCSG announces 2026 Adult Education Student and Teacher of the Year Award winners - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: ATLANTA — The Technical College System of Georgia (TCSG) has announced the recipients of its 2026 statewide adult education honors, recognizing a student and instructor whose dedication reflects the life-changing impact of adult learning programs across Georgia.

item.title: Russell named Teacher of the Year at Thomas County Middle School - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: THOMASVILLE — Jill Russell has been named Teacher of the Year at Thomas County Middle School, a well-deserved honor for an educator whose dedication to students has spanned nearly three decades.

item.title: Rose City Performing Arts’ Elevate Dance Force earns top honors at regional competition - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: THOMASVILLE — Rose City Performing Arts’ competitive dance team, the Elevate Dance Force, returned home with major accomplishments following a successful weekend at their first “away” competition of the season.

item.description: I taught high school for 30 years. There were a lot of lessons taught in my classroom over those years, but none as important as the lessons I want to attempt to re-teach today.

item.title: My Side of the Story- Week 25 - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: THOMASVILLE — In the Spring of 2026, Thomasville Center for the Arts will launch “My Side of the Story” with multiple public art activations during the Center’s Due South Music, Food, &amp; Art Festival and continue through the 105th Rose Show and Festival.

item.title: City invites community to Easter Eggstravaganza - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: THOMASVILLE — The City of Thomasville and over 40 participating and contributing community partners invite the community to the 2026 Easter Eggstravaganza.

item.description: THOMASVILLE — The final performance of the 2025-26 Thomasville Entertainment Foundation Family Series is set to celebrate America’s 250th birthday with a free, one-hour musical journey of songs from various chapters of American history.

item.title: GCSO rounds up five drug arrests through traffic stops, search warrant - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: CAIRO — The Grady County Sheriff’s Office has arrested five individuals on drug-related charges following a series of investigations by its Patrol Division, K-9 unit, and Drug Unit.

item.title: THS Track Shines in South Ga Small School Championship - Thomasville Times-Enterprise
item.description: QUITMAN – The Thomasville Boys and Girls track teams both placed first in the BSN Sports South Georgia Small School Championship on Saturday.
